Oneliner

Launch a satellite into space designed to teach and popularize astronomy and cosmonautics.

Description

Planetum will be the first organization of its kind in the world to launch a satellite into space designed to teach and popularize astronomy and cosmonautics. The control center in the Prague Planetarium will be open to school excursions, as well as to various workshops.
